\section{Design}
\label{sec:design}

\examplesys{} has two parts, a predictor and a fetcher (Figure~\ref{fig:arch}).
The predictor reads the request log; the fetcher acts on its ranking.

\begin{figure}[t]
\centering
\input{figures/arch.tex}
\caption{\examplesys{} sits between the client and the cache.}
\label{fig:arch}
\end{figure}

\subsection{Predictor}
\textbf{Ranking.} The predictor counts how often two requests follow each other within ten steps.
It ranks the candidates by that count.
